In this guide, we'll walk you through the complete infrastructure setup to process Bitcoin payments for your ebook sales, with no reliance on Stripe or other major payment platforms. By the end of this guide, you'll have a fully functional payment and delivery pipeline, ready to accept Bitcoin for your ebook sales.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and Gumroad have failed authors in restricted countries because they often rely on local bank networks, which are frequently unstable or unavailable. This leaves authors with limited options for accepting payments from their customers. However, with the combination of NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can create a payment and delivery pipeline that is completely independent of these platforms. By using NOWPayments' direct on-chain verification and Cloudflare Workers' serverless backend logic, you can bypass the need for local bank networks and ensure that your customers can pay for your ebooks in Bitcoin without any issues.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up the payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need a few essential tools and services. First, you'll need to sign up for a NOWPayments account, which will give you access to their API and on-chain verification services. Next, you'll need to create a Cloudflare Workers account, which will provide you with the serverless backend logic needed to process payments and deliver ebooks. Additionally, you'll need to set up a GitHub Pages site to host your ebook files and a Supabase database to store order information. Finally, you'll need to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered properly. For a comprehensive setup, consider investing in the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes all the necessary tools and services pre-configured and tested.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have all the necessary tools and services, you can start setting up your payment and delivery pipeline. First, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers backend, which will allow you to process payments and verify on-chain transactions. Next, you'll need to set up a GitHub Pages site to host your ebook files and configure your Supabase database to store order information. Finally, you'll need to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered properly. With these steps, you'll have a fully functional payment and delivery pipeline that can handle Bitcoin payments for your ebook sales.
You can process Bitcoin payments for your ebook sales without relying on Stripe or other major payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you'll need to add your ebook files to your GitHub Pages site and configure your Supabase database to store order information. Next, you'll need to test your payment and delivery pipeline by making a purchase using a test Bitcoin address. Once you've verified that everything is working correctly, you can make your ebook available for sale and start processing transactions. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll have a pre-configured and tested payment and delivery pipeline that's ready to go live.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is up and running, you can start scaling your ebook sales. To do this, you'll need to monitor your Supabase database for order information and adjust your Cloudflare Workers backend as needed to handle increased traffic. Additionally, you'll need to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered properly even as your sales increase. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll have a pre-configured and tested payment and delivery pipeline that's designed to scale with your business.

The most important thing to remember when setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is to ensure that your NOWPayments account is properly configured and integrated with your Cloudflare Workers backend. This will allow you to process payments and verify on-chain transactions correctly, and will give you the confidence to go live and start processing transactions. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll be able to set up a fully functional payment and delivery pipeline that can handle Bitcoin payments for your ebook sales, with no reliance on Stripe or other major payment platforms.
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% on every sale, significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad.

Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a NOWPayments account?

To set up a NOWPayments account, simply visit their website and follow the registration process. You'll need to provide some basic information, such as your name and email address, and then you'll be able to access their API and on-chain verification services.
What is Cloudflare Workers and how do I use it?

Cloudflare Workers is a serverless backend logic service that allows you to process payments and verify on-chain transactions. To use it, you'll need to create a Cloudflare Workers account and then integrate it with your NOWPayments account. You can then use Cloudflare Workers to process payments and deliver ebooks to your customers.
How do I set up a GitHub Pages site to host my ebook files?

To set up a GitHub Pages site, simply create a new repository on GitHub and then add your ebook files to it. You can then configure your GitHub Pages settings to host your ebook files and make them available for download.
What is Supabase and how do I use it?

Supabase is a database service that allows you to store order information and other data related to your ebook sales. To use it, you'll need to create a Supabase account and then integrate it with your GitHub Pages site. You can then use Supabase to store order information and adjust your Cloudflare Workers backend as needed to handle increased traffic.
How do I configure my SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings?

To configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings, you'll need to create a TXT record in your DNS settings that includes the necessary information. You can then use a tool like Mailchimp to help you configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings and ensure that your emails are delivered properly.

NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% on every sale, which is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad.
